text: Total revenue for the third quarter of 2024 was $92,995 million, compared with $93,210 million in the prior-year period. Net earnings attributable to shareholders were $26.3 billion.
Acme Corp reported net sales of $1,200 million for fiscal 2025, up from $1,000 million in fiscal 2024. The company expects revenue of approximately $1,400 million next year.
Quarterly revenue was $4.2 billion. The company does not provide forward-looking guidance. Risk factors include supply chain disruption and currency volatility.
